overall_assessment: The main heading split is largely intact across all 20 sampled courses, but mandatory requirements still leak into teaching methods, workload contaminates 16 teaching sections, and several local semantic errors remain. All 20 attendance appendix items were judged correct and 0 wrong; the sampled MA-457 attendance sentence was removed from teaching when moved, with no evidence of duplication introduced by that move. Empty/short and repeated prerequisite/assessment flags are mostly false alarms; the reading-list leak flags identify language metadata rather than missing bibliographies, the practicum leak is real, LFT110 duplication is already present in the source, and the blob flags expose two fulltext/section inconsistencies.

findings.evidence: This course is offered during summer and will be based on lectures, working groups, seminars and a role play. Students are expected to engage actively.
findings.description: For both courses the supplied full course plan contains only a title, credits and responsible faculty, yet five or six substantive sections are emitted. Thus the blob flags indicate disagreement between the declared ground truth and section output, rather than an oversized merged section. The section text is internally plausible, so this is not evidence that the extractor fabricated it; nevertheless its provenance cannot be verified against the published course_plan and these records violate fulltext/section consistency.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The HTML section reader retains blocks independently of fulltext anonymization. R/anonymize.R::.anon_uia removes an Emneansvarlig block until another colon-ended label; when none follows, that rule can consume the remaining full plan while separately extracted section blocks survive.
findings.suggested_fix: Compare fulltext and section blocks for these two source IDs; bound .anon_uia staff removal at any structural heading, not only a colon-ended field, and rebuild both outputs from the same retained blocks. Add a consistency check that substantive section text survives in the anonymized source course_plan.

findings.evidence: Det vil derfor være krav om obligatorisk deltakelse i undervisningen.
findings.description: Compulsory attendance remains in teaching_methods for both PED420 years and PED421; the random MA-314 control likewise retains its three compulsory supervision hours there. MA-457 (2025) leaves the explicit obligatory-work requirement and its Canvas specification in teaching_methods. These are coursework requirements by meaning, even where the exam-admission block repeats the same condition. The random ME-434 control also retains its compulsory gathering in teaching. This is a residual classification problem beyond the 20 correctly classified appendix moves, not evidence that a moved sentence was copied instead of removed.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::.attendance_sentence_regex is anchored to a limited opening vocabulary and misses Det vil derfor være krav and Normalt tilbys det ... obligatoriske; .gate_sentence_regex also requires an explicit exam/course-access condition and does not catch Det er obligatoriske arbeidskrav on its own.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrowly scoped sentence patterns for explicit mandatory participation, compulsory supervision hours and Det er obligatoriske arbeidskrav; move associated specification sentences with their requirement. For mixed sentences retain teaching quantities in teaching_methods while assigning the compulsory condition to coursework_requirements, using the separate explicit requirement text when available; preserve negation, recommendation and graded-practice guards.

findings.evidence: Forventet arbeidsomfang i emnet er omtrent 267 timer.
findings.description: Sixteen of the 20 sampled courses retain total course-workload estimates in teaching_methods, including all six random controls. course_plan_spec.md explicitly places workload in the full plan only, outside all seven sections. These totals are not the duration of a particular teaching activity and therefore contaminate teaching-method data.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::.logistics_sentences removes workload for PHS and some HVL text but has no UiA rule for arbeidsomfang, arbeidsmengde, Arbeidsomfanget or total arbeidstimer.
findings.suggested_fix: Add UiA sentence removal for explicit total expected course-workload estimates, including the approximately/ca. forms and unpunctuated lines. Keep these sentences in course_plan, and preserve activity-specific durations such as supervision hours and practice days.

findings.evidence:
Undervisningsspråk: norsk
Litteratur: norsk og engelsk
findings.description: Three teaching sections retain inline language metadata. The leak->reading_list flag is a real cleanliness signal, but Litteratur: norsk og engelsk supplies the language of readings, not a bibliography to extract. Neither that line nor a bare teaching-language field describes a teaching method; both belong only in the full plan.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The UiA HTML reader recognizes structural Undervisningsspråk headings, but language fields embedded as ordinary lines under Undervisnings- og læringsformer remain inside that section.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip UiA lines consisting solely of Undervisningsspråk or Litteratur followed by language names from section text. Retain substantive reading references and teaching descriptions; do not manufacture a reading_list row from a language-only field.

findings.evidence: Faget i praksis. I løpet av de 5 dagene i praksis skal det legges til rette for at studenten får erfaring med bruk av ulike undervisningsressurser i matematikk og elevaktive undervisningsmetoder.
findings.description: The 2025 MA-457 course_content includes an inline Faget i praksis paragraph describing practice-based teaching arrangements. It belongs in teaching_methods. The 2024 version correctly moves the equivalent paragraph because Faget i praksis is a separate subheading; the 2025 inline variant is not read as a heading, confirming the leak->teaching_methods flag.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/institution_config.R uses UiA section_subheading_selector = p, but heading recognition requires a separate heading-shaped paragraph; the section_heading_map.R mapping for Faget i praksis cannot split a paragraph that contains its own body text.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize an exact paragraph-start Faget i praksis. label in UiA blocks, split off its following text as a teaching_methods block, and end it at the next structural heading. Preserve the existing standalone-subheading behavior.

findings.evidence: I tillegg kreves dokumentasjon av minimum to års yrkespraksis.
findings.description: The random FIL908N control emits only the second sentence of its general admission requirements as prerequisites. The preceding general-study-competence admission sentence is correctly removed, but this continuation is still an admission/documentation condition and does not name required subject knowledge or prior courses. The surviving row also loses the referent of I tillegg.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::.is_admission_sentence operates sentence by sentence; .admission_line_regex does not recognize this documentation continuation, while .real_prerequisite_regex treats i tillegg as a signal to retain text.
findings.suggested_fix: When a general-admission sentence is removed, also remove its immediately following I tillegg ... documentation/years-of-employment continuation if it contains no subject-specific knowledge or course requirement. Preserve actual subject prerequisites and keep the admission text in course_plan.

findings.evidence: The content of the course must be approved by the PhD programme committee for natural sciences (PECNAT) at the Department of Natural Sciences.
findings.description: BIO601 labels committee approval of the course content as prerequisites, although it states neither required nor recommended prior subject knowledge. The identical sentence is already in coursework_requirements under the exam-admission heading; the dup_in_course flag therefore exposes an unnecessary, semantically incorrect prerequisite copy. The coursework occurrence can express the stated pre-assessment approval condition without also creating a prior-knowledge requirement.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading-based assignment retains this sentence under Forkunnskapskrav, and the admission filter does not recognize course-content committee approval as distinct from subject prerequisites.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the specific course-content committee-approval formulation from prerequisites and keep a single occurrence under the stated coursework approval condition. Do not deduplicate arbitrary prerequisite/coursework text without first checking its meaning.

findings.evidence: It provides in-depth exploration of a selected topic relevant to the candidate’s PhD project or research interests.
findings.description: BIO601 learning_outcomes begins with two sentences about the externally completed summer-school basis and the scope of the course. They describe course structure/content, not what the candidate knows or can do after completion. Actual outcomes begin at After completing the course, the candidate is expected to: and are otherwise preserved.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R::.split_lo_intro is enabled only for PHS and requires a knowledge/skills group heading. UiA BIO601 instead separates its descriptive introduction from actual outcomes with an English outcomes lead-in.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a UiA BIO601-compatible split before the exact After completing the course, the candidate is expected to: lead-in: move the preceding descriptive course introduction to course_content while retaining the lead-in and every outcome in learning_outcomes. Restrict the rule to descriptive introductions so genuine outcome prose is preserved.
